_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for the Outer Banks. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Kitty Hawk Kites
deals.deal: 10% off hang gliding, kayak eco-tours and kiteboarding lessons for military
deals.details: Year-round for military members and immediate family on dune hang gliding lessons, tandem hang gliding flights, kayak eco-tours and kiteboarding lessons. Military groups get up to 20% off select recreation from Labor Day to Memorial Day.
deals.location: Kitty Hawk Kites (multiple Outer Banks locations)

deals.name: Kitty Hawk Kites
deals.deal: Buy one adventure gift certificate, get a second 50% off
deals.details: Limited-time offer applied automatically as 25% off each of two certificates, no code needed. Covers hang gliding, kayak and paddleboard tours, dolphin cruises, wild horse tours, kiteboarding and more; no end date stated.
deals.location: Kitty Hawk Kites (multiple Outer Banks locations)

deals.name: Kitty Hawk Kites
deals.deal: Kitty Hawk Maritime Forest kayak tour $39 per adult booked online (regularly $45)
deals.details: Off-season kayak tour in Kitty Hawk Woods Coastal Preserve; the online price is $39 per adult.

deals.name: Roanoke Island Festival Park
deals.deal: 25% off admission for groups of 10 or more
deals.details: Group rate of $11.25 ages 13 and up and $9.75 ages 3-12 (regular $15 and $13) for 10 or more paying visitors who book ahead and pay together. Park open Tuesday-Saturday 9 AM-5 PM through December 31, 2026.

deals.name: Jolly Roger Restaurant & Bar
deals.deal: Half-price Bloody Marys and mimosas on Sunday
deals.details: Sunday special listed with Soul Food Sunday on the restaurant's daily specials page.

deals.name: Captain George's Seafood Restaurant
deals.deal: All-you-can-eat seafood buffet $41.99 on November Sundays
deals.details: Every Sunday in November the buffet is $41.99 (regularly $51.99). Sunday buffet hours at Kill Devil Hills are 12-8:30 PM.

deals.name: Captain George's Seafood Restaurant
deals.deal: First Catch Sunday: $46.99 adult buffet, 12-4 PM
deals.details: Sunday adult buffet price from noon to 4 PM at all four locations, excluding Easter, Mother's Day and Father's Day.

deals.name: Hurricane Mo's Beachside Bar & Grill
deals.deal: 25-cent steamed shrimp, 50-cent wings, $1 hard tacos, $1.50 soft tacos
deals.details: Daily happy hour, listed as 3-6 PM off season; the menu says orders must be in by 5 PM. Dine-in only, no split checks.

deals.name: Jolly Roger Restaurant & Bar
deals.details: Daily pub specials from 4 to 6:30 PM, dine-in at the bar only.

deals.name: Outer Banks Brewing Station
deals.deal: $2 oysters, $3 grilled oysters, $7 smash burger, $1 wings at happy hour
deals.details: Happy hour 3-6 PM with Little Star oysters half shell or steamed $2 each, garlic-butter grilled oysters and Oysters Rockefeller $3 each (minimum 3 per style and 4 wings). Listed on the brewery calendar on multiple dates, including Nov 24-27.
